list.name: instrument_type
list.label: Type
list.query: Futures : future, Options : option, Weekly / daily options : weekly_option, Single stock futures : stock_future, Other : other

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query:
SELECT ticker
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY max(other_limit) DESC, count(*) DESC, ticker
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Total other limit (latest day)
panels.description: Sum of the other limit of the selected tickers on the latest day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT sum(other_limit)::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Tickers with a limit (latest day)
panels.description: How many of the selected tickers have a non-zero other limit on the latest day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE other_limit > 0) AS tickers
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Latest trading day
panels.description: Most recent trading day with data for the selected tickers in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)

panels.title: Other limit per ticker
panels.description: Daily other limit per selected ticker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Change since start of range
panels.description: Other limit relative to each ticker's first value in the range, to compare tickers on one scale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT time, ticker, other_limit / nullif(first_value(other_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily change
panels.description: Other limit minus the previous trading day's value per selected ticker; the legend sum is the net change in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, ticker, other_limit - lag(other_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time) AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, ticker, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Share of total other limit
panels.description: Each selected ticker's other limit over the sum across all tickers of the selected types that day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
tot AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, sum(other_limit) AS total
  FROM d
  GROUP BY trad_dt
)
SELECT d.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, d.ticker, d.other_limit / nullif(tot.total, 0) AS share
FROM d
JOIN tot ON tot.trad_dt = d.trad_dt
WHERE d.ticker IN ($ticker)
ORDER BY time, d.ticker

panels.title: Total other limit, stacked by ticker
panels.description: Daily other limit of the selected tickers, stacked so the top edge is the total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
  AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Instruments listed per day by product (top 10)
panels.description: Instruments of the selected types per day by product root, stacked (rest as 'others'); ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, CASE WHEN length(ticker) = 8 THEN left(ticker, 4) ELSE left(ticker, 3) END AS product
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT product FROM d GROUP BY product ORDER BY count(*) DESC, product LIMIT 10
)
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  CASE WHEN product IN (SELECT product FROM top_products) THEN product ELSE 'others' END AS product,
  count(*) AS instruments
FROM d
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, product

panels.title: Instruments added / removed per day
panels.description: Instruments of the selected types that appeared (positive) or disappeared (negative) vs the previous trading day; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt, ticker
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM d)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT d.trad_dt, d.ticker, days.prev_dt
  FROM d
  JOIN days ON days.trad_dt = d.trad_dt
  WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
),
prv AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, d.ticker
  FROM days
  JOIN d ON d.trad_dt = days.prev_dt
),
added AS (
  SELECT c.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM cur c
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = c.prev_dt AND p.ticker = c.ticker
  GROUP BY c.trad_dt
),
removed AS (
  SELECT p.trad_dt, count(*) AS n
  FROM prv p
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = p.trad_dt AND c.ticker = p.ticker
  GROUP BY p.trad_dt
)
SELECT days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  coalesce(a.n, 0) AS "Added",
  -coalesce(r.n, 0) AS "Removed"
FROM days
LEFT JOIN added a ON a.trad_dt = days.trad_dt
LEFT JOIN removed r ON r.trad_dt = days.trad_dt
WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Limit curve: start vs end of range
panels.description: Other limit per ticker on the first and latest day in the range, ordered by maturity; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, ticker, other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_dt, max(trad_dt) AS last_dt FROM d
),
curve AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    max(other_limit) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = first_dt) AS start_of_range,
    max(other_limit) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = last_dt) AS latest_day
  FROM d, bounds
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT ticker, start_of_range, latest_day
FROM curve
WHERE start_of_range > 0 OR latest_day > 0
ORDER BY try_cast(substr(ticker, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) NULLS LAST, position(substr(ticker, 4, 1) IN 'FGHJKMNQUVXZ'), ticker

panels.title: Selected tickers (latest day in range)
panels.description: Limits of the selected tickers on the latest day vs the previous day and the start of the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *, CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END AS instrument_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
),
rng AS (
  SELECT ticker,
    arg_min(other_limit, trad_dt) AS first_other_limit,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE other_limit > 0) AS days_with_limit
  FROM d
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT c.ticker,
  c.instrument_id,
  c.instrument_type AS type,
  c.liquidity_limit::DOUBLE AS liquidity_limit,
  r.first_other_limit::DOUBLE AS range_start_other_limit,
  p.other_limit::DOUBLE AS prev_other_limit,
  c.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit,
  (c.other_limit - p.other_limit)::DOUBLE AS other_limit_change,
  r.days_with_limit
FROM cur c
LEFT JOIN prv p ON p.ticker = c.ticker
LEFT JOIN rng r ON r.ticker = c.ticker
ORDER BY c.other_limit DESC, c.ticker

panels.title: Largest other limits (latest day)
panels.description: Top 20 other limits in the selected types on the latest day; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, ticker, other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT c.ticker,
  p.other_limit::DOUBLE AS prev_other_limit,
  c.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit,
  (c.other_limit - p.other_limit)::DOUBLE AS change
FROM cur c
LEFT JOIN prv p ON p.ticker = c.ticker
WHERE c.other_limit > 0
ORDER BY c.other_limit DESC, c.ticker
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Biggest limit changes (range)
panels.description: Top 20 absolute changes from first to last other limit in the range in the selected types; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    ticker,
    arg_min(other_limit, trad_dt)::DOUBLE AS first_other_limit,
    arg_max(other_limit, trad_dt)::DOUBLE AS last_other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT ticker,
  first_other_limit,
  last_other_limit,
  last_other_limit - first_other_limit AS change,
  last_other_limit / nullif(first_other_limit, 0) - 1 AS change_pct
FROM r
WHERE last_other_limit <> first_other_limit
ORDER BY abs(last_other_limit - first_other_limit) DESC, ticker
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Instruments added / removed (latest day)
panels.description: Instruments of the selected types added or removed vs the previous trading day; ignores the ticker filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, ticker, instrument_id, other_limit
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT 'added' AS status, c.ticker, c.instrument_id, c.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM cur c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prv p WHERE p.instrument_id = c.instrument_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prv)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'removed' AS status, p.ticker, p.instrument_id, p.other_limit::DOUBLE AS other_limit
FROM prv p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cur c WHERE c.instrument_id = p.instrument_id)
ORDER BY status, ticker
LIMIT 2000

panels.title: $ticker limits
panels.description: Daily other limit and liquidity limit, one panel per selected ticker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  other_limit::DOUBLE AS "Other limit",
  liquidity_limit::DOUBLE AS "Liquidity limit"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_daily_liquidity_limits_other/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE ticker = $ticker
  AND CASE length(ticker) WHEN 6 THEN 'future' WHEN 8 THEN 'stock_future' WHEN 13 THEN 'option' WHEN 15 THEN 'weekly_option' WHEN 17 THEN 'weekly_option' ELSE 'other' END IN ($instrument_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time
